mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refundCount, MAX(refund_rate) AS refundRate, NVL(SUM(no_show_count), 0) AS noShowCount, MAX(no_show_rate) AS noShowRate FROM TR_NOSHOW_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT age_group AS ageGroup, NVL(SUM(no_show_count), 0) AS noShowCount, NVL(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refundCount FROM TR_NOSHOW_AGE WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY age_group
